ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the feature section. HTML is allowed.
SectionHeading.placeholder: Everything you need to move faster.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Bring analytics, security, and reporting together in one focused experience.

ImageCount.helper: Choose whether this section renders only the primary image or the current two-image overlapping composition. Secondary image fields are used only when Two Images is selected.

PrimaryImage.helper: Primary image used in both one-image and two-image modes. Recommended minimum size: 1200px wide by 1400px tall.

PrimaryImageAltText.helper: Describe the primary image for accessibility and SEO.

SecondaryImage.helper: Used only when Image Count is Two Images. Secondary image shown as the smaller overlapping photo. Recommended minimum size: 1000px wide by 1200px tall.

SecondaryImageAltText.helper: Used only when Image Count is Two Images. Describe the secondary image for accessibility and SEO.

Features.helper: Add four or more feature rows in display order. When more than four rows are added, the template automatically uses compact spacing.

IconClass.helper: Font Awesome class for the icon.

IconTheme.helper: Choose one visual theme. This controls both the icon color and circular background.

Title.helper: Required. Feature title. HTML is allowed.

Description.helper: Required. Short supporting description. HTML is allowed.
Description.placeholder: Track performance as it happens with clear dashboards and actionable signals.
